# Full REAL-Q Python dependencies: core, GPU acceleration and reasoning eval.
# Install core first: python -m pip install -r requirements-core.txt
# Then: python -m pip install --no-build-isolation -r requirements.txt
# CUDA extensions require a matching CUDA toolkit / compiler.
-r requirements-core.txt

# Packaging and CUDA extension builds.
setuptools>=64
wheel
packaging
ninja

# FlashAttention-4 adapter: keep this pair pinned together.
flash-attn-4==4.0.0b25
quack-kernels==0.5.3
einops==0.8.1
# Match the Triton version required by torch 2.9.1 on Linux x86_64.
triton==3.5.1; platform_system == "Linux" and platform_machine == "x86_64"
# The Hadamard extension is optional at runtime (a torch fallback is bundled).
# This revision includes CUDA 12.8 SM100 / SM120 code generation.
fast-hadamard-transform @ git+https://github.com/Dao-AILab/fast-hadamard-transform.git@e7706faf8d1c3b9f241e36860640ad1dac644ede

# Math-Verify, EvalPlus and the pinned LiveCodeBench evaluator's runtime.
-r benchmarks/requirements.txt
pandas
pebble>=5.1.0
# LiveCodeBench imports these prompt constants even for local scoring.
anthropic>=0.42.0

# LiveCodeBench source dependency (official execution scoring only):
# https://github.com/LiveCodeBench/LiveCodeBench.git
# revision: 28fef95ea8c9f7a547c8329f2cd3d32b92c1fa24
# Its upstream wheel omits evaluator subpackages. Use the source checkout
# instructions in docs/DEPENDENCIES.md and pass --lcb-source /path/to/checkout.
